page.overview:
Who is Adelorna Bastine?

Adelorna Bastine is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah, and secretly the head of her Ajah, referred to as the Captain-General. She has two Warders, one of whom is named Talric.

She is short and slim, but wears an aura of confidence around her giving her natural authority, making it easy to ignore her short figure. She is around the same height as Egwene. She has dark hair and blue, slanted eyes.

Adelorna has a strength in the One Power of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. She can Travel.

Adelorna was born in the year in Saldaea.
